svg.aria-label: Agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, ChatGPT and your own scripts call Switchboard, which applies policy, runs typed tools and logs every call, and reaches Plex, Apple Home, PlayStation 5, Things 3, notes and the home servers.
